**Implementation note:** Volume and imbalance bars only; no momentum rule.

## Description

Samples financial tick data using volume-synchronized probability or information-driven bars (volume clocks) rather than calendar time to equalize information content and trade order flow imbalances.

## Where it may fit

High-frequency intraday momentum, volatile earnings releases, uneven intraday liquidity periods.

## Vehicles

High-frequency trading firms, intraday quantitative prop funds.

## Required data

Tick-level trade volume and price messages, volume threshold calibration parameters.

## Caveats

Bar arrival rates vary dynamically with market activity; backtesting engine must support event-driven non-clock bar indexing.
